rule.primary: highest count of strict POLICY successes across the 18 non-control discovery trials
rule.secondary: highest count of post-assessment semantic successes
rule.note: explicit counts only; a three-state/six-trial grid is not a statistical reliability claim and no success rate is inferred

aa_control.note: repeatability evidence only; bitwise CUDA determinism is not claimed or asserted

discovery_summary.note: explicit paired counts only; three states x two model seeds is not a statistical reliability claim and no success rate is inferred
